gfx_device.cpp, desktop_mode.cpp, sky_render.cpp, Render/Step/WM_PAINT/WM_SIZE/WM_DISPLAYCHANGE/WM_DPICHANGED in main.cpp, device-loss handlers, launcher window lifetime, transitions.
workshop_assets.cpp, settings_io.cpp, extension_content.cpp, crash_dump.cpp, util.cpp, CMakeLists.txt POST_BUILD vs runtime expectations; COM release balance.
